diagnostic_scope: FIXED 100-SAMPLE CV-BENCH SCREENING (screening100). This is a single-variable per-sample budget-schedule diagnostic at the layer-5 cut point and is explicitly NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion. It compares the layer-5 adaptive hardware-rule budget (real-only unbounded global-L2 + 3x3 anchor selection) against the existing fixed-K=96 unbounded real-only artifact; no formal accuracy, promotion, acceleration or hardware claim may be derived from it.
round_scope: CPU-only preregistration, summariser and tests. No GPU run, no board run, no training, no hyper-parameter tuning, no dependency installation. The adaptive-budget arm raw JSONL is produced later by the host GPU runner exactly as pinned below; it did not exist when this file was written.
experiment_question: Holding the screening100 manifest, the layer-5 cut point, region_grid=3, the frozen unbounded real-only global-L2 + 3x3 anchor selection algorithm, all-real emission, BF16/SDPA and greedy decoding fixed, does replacing the single fixed budget K=96 with the per-sample adaptive hardware-rule budget K_raw = max(96, ceil(0.25*G)), K_eff = min(G, 16*ceil(K_raw/16)) (identity bypass when K_eff >= G) change the official CV-Bench screening100 accuracy relative to the fixed-K96 arm?

single_variable_contract.baseline: existing fixed-K=96 layer-5 unbounded real-only artifact (artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-unbounded-real-only/layer5_unbounded_real_only_k96_screening100.jsonl, SHA256 fd22c5a4b1941a8ad0a2c47bf15f0abcbeaa56553a9f9a790deb6e14054df94c)
single_variable_contract.reference: frozen custom dense (unpruned) full2638 path restricted to the 100 screening ids; REFERENCE ONLY, never decision-driving
identical: frozen unbounded real-only global-L2 + 3x3 anchor selection algorithm
all output slots are raw real 2x2 groups (no context pooling, no context slot reservation, no local candidate cap)
DeepStack index 5 called on the compact hidden
blocks 0..5 full then blocks 6..23 on the compact sequence
single_variable_contract.only_change: The per-sample token budget stops being a constant K=96 and becomes the adaptive hardware-rule budget derived from the real G = full_llm_visual_tokens: K_raw = max(96, ceil(0.25*G)), K_eff = min(G, 16*ceil(K_raw/16)), identity bypass when K_eff >= G.
single_variable_contract.verification: The adaptive runner records budget_mode='adaptive_layer5_unbounded_real_only', budget_formula, budget_min=96, budget_retention_ratio=0.25, budget_alignment=16, full_llm_visual_tokens, raw_budget, effective_budget, requested_budget, adaptive_retention and identity_bypass; it fail-closes unless the integration was called with the formula K_eff, the emission is exactly K_eff or the identity bypass, and the all-real / no-context contract holds. The summariser re-derives K_raw/K_eff/retention/identity from full_llm_visual_tokens and re-checks everything, failing closed on any violation.
forbidden_changes: no change to the frozen unbounded real-only selection algorithm
no change to BF16 / SDPA / greedy decoding

fixed_configuration.budget_formula: K_raw = max(96, ceil(0.25 * G)); K_eff = min(G, 16 * ceil(K_raw / 16)); identity_bypass if K_eff >= G (G = full_llm_visual_tokens)

arms.dense: frozen custom dense (unpruned) path; REFERENCE ONLY, never decision-driving
arms.fixed_k96: existing fixed-K=96 layer-5 unbounded real-only artifact
arms.adaptive: layer-5 adaptive-budget unbounded real-only global-L2 + 3x3 anchor arm

primary_metric.definition: Official CV-Bench combined score returned by the frozen scorer evaluation.build_cv_bench_pruning_report.score: ((accuracy_ADE20K + accuracy_COCO)/2 + accuracy_Omni3D)/2.
primary_metric.rule: This is the ONE and ONLY primary metric for every arm (dense, fixed_k96, adaptive) and for every paired bootstrap comparison. It is never replaced by any other accuracy.

unweighted_metric.definition: Plain unweighted mean over the 100 screening samples.
unweighted_metric.rule: Secondary diagnostic only. It must never be called the CV-Bench primary score and must never drive the decision rule.

dense.subset_rule: restricted to the 100 sample_id values of datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl, preserving manifest order
dense.role: REFERENCE ONLY: unpruned custom-dense reference; it never drives the decision

fixed_k96.role: existing fixed-K=96 layer-5 unbounded real-only artifact, screening100; the paired baseline

adaptive.role: layer-5 adaptive-budget unbounded real-only global-L2 + 3x3 anchor arm, screening100
adaptive.generation_command: python evaluation/run_hf_hardware_regular_layer5_adaptive_budget.py --model <frozen BF16 RoboBrain2.5-4B> --model-label <label> --manifest datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl --output artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-adaptive-budget/layer5_adaptive_budget_screening100.jsonl --score-mode l2 --prune-after-layer 5 --region-grid 3 --dtype bf16 --device cuda:0

validation_requirements.sample_id_identity: The screening manifest, the dense full2638 subset, the fixed-K96 arm and the adaptive arm must all select exactly the same 100 sample_id values.
validation_requirements.no_duplicates: Each of the four inputs must contain no duplicate sample_id.
validation_requirements.score_mode_l2: Every fixed-K96 and every adaptive record must have score_mode == "l2".
validation_requirements.cutpoint_5: Every fixed-K96 and every adaptive record must carry prune_after_layer == 5.
validation_requirements.fixed_k96_budget: Every fixed-K96 record must have requested_budget == 96 and must emit exactly 96 output groups, or the G <= 96 identity bypass.
validation_requirements.adaptive_budget_formula: Every adaptive record's raw_budget / effective_budget / requested_budget / adaptive_retention / identity_bypass must equal the frozen formula re-derived from its real full_llm_visual_tokens.
validation_requirements.adaptive_budget_emission: Every non-bypass adaptive record must emit exactly K_eff output groups; a bypass record must be the K_eff >= G identity bypass and keep exactly G real groups.
validation_requirements.input_grid_consistency: For every sample_id, the adaptive record's (image_grid_thw, full_patch_tokens, full_llm_visual_tokens) must equal the fixed-K96 record's tuple.
validation_requirements.all_real_no_context: Every fixed-K96 and adaptive record must declare selection_rule == "unbounded_real_only_global_l2_3x3_anchor", uses_context_pooling == false, uses_context_slot_reservation == false, uses_local_candidate_cap == false, local_candidate_cap null and context_group_count == 0; source_type must be all 0 (SOURCE_REAL) and real_group_count must equal output_group_count.
validation_requirements.selection_metadata_identity: NOT required between the fixed-K96 and adaptive arms: the single changed variable is the per-sample budget, so selected_group_indices/source_type/region_id legitimately differ. The summariser must never require cross-arm metadata identity.
validation_requirements.input_sha256: Every non-null inputs_sha256 pin in this file is re-verified before scoring.
validation_requirements.fail_closed: If any required input file is missing, or any of the checks above fails, the summariser must raise and must NOT write a report.

decision_rule.uses: 95% paired stratified bootstrap CI on score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] for adaptive_minus_fixed_k96, reported descriptively only
decision_rule.dense_role: reference only; never drives the decision
decision_rule.note: This screening100 diagnostic preregisters no CONFIRMED/NOT_CONFIRMED promotion threshold; it is a budget-schedule attribution signal, not a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion.

explicit_non_formal_statement: This diagnostic runs on a fixed 100-sample screening set. Its result is a per-sample budget-schedule diagnostic signal only and is NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion; it must not be quoted as the official CV-Bench accuracy of any approach, and it does not authorise promotion, RTL work or hardware claims.
limitations: Screening100 is a diagnostic subset, not the formal 2638-sample CV-Bench benchmark.
The Selector path is software only; no FPGA/board result and no latency/acceleration claim is made.

Both Selector arms are raw real groups at the same layer-5 cut point using the same frozen selection algorithm; they differ only in the per-sample budget, so cross-arm selection metadata is not required to match.

The adaptive budget K_eff = min(G, 16*ceil(K_raw/16)) never exceeds the fixed-K96 budget for any sample, so the two arms coincide whenever K_eff == 96 and always coincide on the G <= 96 identity bypass.
Only score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] drives the report; unweighted_sample_accuracy is descriptive.
Neither arm uses the B1-trained Wv projection.
Validation was already used in development; internal test remains sealed.
